physics-killer-01.title: Aiki da sauya makamashin inji
physics-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-01.material: Wani abu yana tashi daga tsaye a wurin A mai tsayin $50\,\mathrm{m}$ a kan hanyar roller coaster mara gogayya. Tsayin wurare uku a kan hanyar kamar yadda tebur ya nuna: wurin B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, wurin C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, wurin D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Idan aka yi watsi da juriyar iska kuma $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, sau nawa gudun a C ya kai gudun a B, da gudun a D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: Wani abu yana tashi daga tsaye a wurin A mai tsayin $50\,\mathrm{m}$ a kan hanyar roller coaster mara gogayya. Tsayin wurare uku a kan hanyar kamar yadda tebur ya nuna: wurin B: $45\,\mathrm{m}$, wurin C: $30\,\mathrm{m}$, wurin D: $5\,\mathrm{m}$. Idan aka yi watsi da juriyar iska kuma $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, sau nawa gudun a C ya kai gudun a B, da gudun a D?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: Tun da abu yana tsaye a A, daga $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ sai $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Don haka $v_C/v_B=2$ sau, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Gudu ba ya daidaita da tsayin da aka sauko, yana daidaita da $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (amsa mara kyau ①); idan aka ɗauki tsayin D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ a matsayin tsayin da aka sauko sai a sami $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (amsa mara kyau ③); idan aka manta da $\frac12$ sai a sami $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (amsa mara kyau ④).
physics-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
